126    private IrCompiler(Model model, boolean coalesceVariables) {
127        this.model = Check.notNull(model);

129    }

131    public static IrSolutionMap compile(IrModule in, Model out) {
132        return compile(in, out, true);
133    }
134
135    public static IrSolutionMap compile(IrModule in, Model out, boolean coalesceVariables) {
136        IrCompiler compiler = new IrCompiler(out, coalesceVariables);
137        return compiler.compile(in);
138    }

140    private IrSolutionMap compile(IrModule module) {
141        IrModule optModule = Optimizer.optimize(module);
142        Coalesce coalesce = new Coalesce();
143        if (coalesceVariables) {
144            Pair<Coalesce, IrModule> coalescePair = new FBBT().propagate(optModule);
145            coalesce = coalescePair.getFst();
146            optModule = coalescePair.getSnd();
147
148            Set<IrVar> processed = new HashSet<>();
149            for (IrExpr expr : optModule.getConstraints()) {
150                if (expr instanceof IrRegister) {
151                    IrVar var = ((IrRegister) expr).getVariable();
152                    if (var instanceof IrBoolVar) {
153                        IrBoolVar bool = (IrBoolVar) var;
154                        bool = coalesce.get(bool);
155                        if (!bool.isConstant() && processed.add(bool)) {
156                            coalescePair = new FBBT().constructiveDisjunction(bool, bool.negate(), optModule);
157                            coalesce = coalesce.compose(coalescePair.getFst());
158                            optModule = coalescePair.getSnd();
159                        }
160                    }
161                }
162            }
163
164            optModule = DuplicateConstraints.removeDuplicates(optModule);
165        }
166        optModule = LinearEquationOptimizer.optimize(optModule);
167        commonSubexpressions.addAll(CommonSubexpression.findCommonSubexpressions(optModule));
168
169        for (IrBoolExpr constraint : optModule.getConstraints()) {
170            Constraint c = compileAsConstraint(constraint);
171            if (ESat.TRUE.equals(c.isSatisfied())) {
172                // Not posted, so that the solver does not report it as free.
173                c.ignore();
174                // TODO
175//                assert constraint instanceof IrRegister;
176            } else {
177                post(c);
178            }
179        }
180
181        return new IrSolutionMap(coalesce, intVarMap, setVarMap);
182    }

198    private void post(Constraint constraint) {
199        model.post(constraint);
200    }
201
202    private BoolVar boolVar(String name, BoolDomain domain) {
203        if (domain.isTrue()) {
204            return model.boolVar(true);
205        }
206        if (domain.isFalse()) {
207            return model.boolVar(false);
208        }
209        return model.boolVar(name);
210    }
211
212    private IntVar intVar(String name, Domain domain) {
213        if (domain.isConstant()) {
214            int constant = domain.getLowBound();
215            switch (domain.getLowBound()) {
216                case 0:
217                    return model.boolVar(false);
218                case 1:
219                    return model.boolVar(true);
220                default:
221                    return model.intVar(constant);
222            }
223        }
224        if (domain.getLowBound() == 0 && domain.getHighBound() == 1) {
225            return model.boolVar(name);
226        }
227        if (domain.isBounded()) {
228            // An enumerated domain of a large interval, e.g. the default range of
229            // decimals, would take a bitset per variable.
230            return model.intVar(name, domain.getLowBound(), domain.getHighBound(),
231                    domain.size() > LargeDomain);
232        }
233        return model.intVar(name, domain.getValues());
234    }
235
236    /**
237     * Intervals with more values are bounded domains in Choco.
238     */
239    private static final int LargeDomain = 1 << 16;
240
241    private SetVar setVar(String name, Domain env, Domain ker) {
242        if (env.size() == ker.size()) {
243            int[] values = ker.getValues();
244            TIntHashSet valueSet = new TIntHashSet(values);
245            SetVar var = cachedSetConstants.get(valueSet);
246            if (var == null) {
247                var = model.setVar(values);
248                cachedSetConstants.put(valueSet, var);
249            }
250            return var;
251        }
252        return model.setVar(name, ker.getValues(), env.getValues());
253    }
254
255    private SetVar setVar(String name, Domain env, Domain ker, Domain card) {
256        if (card.getLowBound() == env.size()) {
257            return model.setVar(env.getValues());
258        }
259        if (card.getHighBound() == ker.size()) {
260            return model.setVar(ker.getValues());
261        }
262        SetVar set = setVar(name, env, ker);
263        // TODO: not always needed
264        set.setCard(model.intVar("|" + name + "|", card.getValues()));
265        return set;
266    }
267
268    private CStringVar cstring(String name, Domain[] chars, Domain length) {
269        IntVar[] $chars = new IntVar[chars.length];
270        for (int i = 0; i < $chars.length; i++) {
271            $chars[i] = intVar(name + "[" + i + "]", chars[i]);
272        }
273        IntVar $length = intVar("|" + name + "|", length);
274        return new CStringVar($chars, $length);
275    }

293    private SetVar[] numSetVars(String name, Domain[] envs, Domain[] kers, Domain[] cards) {
294        SetVar[] sets = new SetVar[envs.length];
295        for (int i = 0; i < sets.length; i++) {
296            sets[i] = setVar(name + "[" + i + "]#" + varNum++, envs[i], kers[i], cards[i]);
297        }
298        return sets;

305    private BoolVar getBoolVar(IrBoolVar var) {
306        BoolVar boolVar = (BoolVar) intVarMap.get(var);
307        if (boolVar == null) {
308            boolVar = boolVar(var.getName(), var.getDomain());
309            intVarMap.put(var, boolVar);
310        }
311        return boolVar;
312    }
313
314    private IntVar getIntVar(IrIntVar var) {
315        IntVar intVar = intVarMap.get(var);
316        if (intVar == null) {
317            intVar = intVar(var.getName(), var.getDomain());
318            intVarMap.put(var, intVar);
319        }
320        return intVar;
321    }
322
323    private SetVar getSetVar(IrSetVar var) {
324        SetVar setVar = setVarMap.get(var);
325        if (setVar == null) {
326            if (var.isConstant()) {
327                setVar = setVar(var.getName(), var.getKer(), var.getKer());
328            } else {
329                IntVar setCardVar = getIntVar(var.getCardVar());
330                setVar = setVar(var.getName(), var.getEnv(), var.getKer());
331                setVar.setCard(setCardVar);
332            }
333            setVarMap.put(var, setVar);
334        }
335        return setVar;
336    }

338    private BoolVar asBoolVar(Object obj) {
339        if (obj instanceof Constraint) {
340            return asBoolVar((Constraint) obj);
341        }
342        return (BoolVar) obj;
343    }
344
345    private BoolVar asBoolVar(Constraint op) {
346        return op.reify();
347    }

349    private BoolVar compileAsBoolVar(IrBoolExpr expr) {
350        return asBoolVar(expr.accept(boolExprCompiler, BoolVarNoReify));
351    }

353    private BoolVar[] compileAsBoolVars(IrBoolExpr[] exprs) {
354        BoolVar[] vars = new BoolVar[exprs.length];
355        for (int i = 0; i < vars.length; i++) {
356            vars[i] = compileAsBoolVar(exprs[i]);
357        }
358        return vars;

373    private Constraint asConstraint(Object obj) {
374        if (obj instanceof BoolVar) {
375            return asConstraint((BoolVar) obj);
376        }
377        return (Constraint) obj;
378    }
379
380    private Constraint asConstraint(BoolVar var) {
381        return _arithm(var, "=", 1);
382    }
383
384    private Constraint compileAsConstraint(IrBoolExpr expr) {
385        return asConstraint(expr.accept(boolExprCompiler, ConstraintNoReify));
386    }
387
388    private Constraint compileAsConstraint(IrBoolExpr expr, BoolVar reify) {
389        BoolArg arg = new BoolArg(reify, Preference.Constraint);
390        Object result = expr.accept(boolExprCompiler, arg);
391        if (result instanceof Constraint) {
392            Constraint constraint = (Constraint) result;
393            if (arg.hasReify()) {
394                // The compliation failed to reify, explicitly reify now.
395                return _arithm(arg.useReify(), "=", constraint.reify());
396            }
397            return constraint;
398        }
399        BoolVar var = (BoolVar) result;
400        if (arg.hasReify()) {
401            return _arithm(arg.useReify(), "=", var);
402        }
403        return asConstraint(var);
404    }

406    private IntVar compileAsEqualVar(IrIntExpr expr, IntVar value) {
407        Object result = commonSubexpressions.contains(expr)
408                ? compile(expr)
409                : expr.accept(intExprCompiler, value);
410        if (result instanceof IntVar) {
411            return _arithm((IntVar) result, "=", value).reify();
412        }
413        return ((Constraint) result).reify();
414    }
415
416    private Constraint compileAsEqual(IrIntExpr expr, IntVar value, BoolVar reify) {
417        Object result = commonSubexpressions.contains(expr)
418                ? compile(expr)
419                : expr.accept(intExprCompiler, value);
420        if (result instanceof IntVar) {
421            // The compliation failed to reify, explicitly reify now.
422            Constraint eq = _arithm(value, "=", (IntVar) result);
423            return _arithm(reify, "=", eq.reify());
424        }
425        return _arithm(((Constraint) result).reify(), "=", reify);
426    }

428    private IntVar compileAsNotEqualVar(IrIntExpr expr, IntVar value) {
429        Object result = commonSubexpressions.contains(expr)
430                ? compile(expr)
431                : expr.accept(intExprCompiler, value);
432        if (result instanceof IntVar) {
433            return _arithm((IntVar) result, "!=", value).reify();
434        }
435        return ((Constraint) result).reify().not();
436    }

438    private Constraint compileAsNotEqual(IrIntExpr expr, IntVar value, BoolVar reify) {
439        Object result = commonSubexpressions.contains(expr)
440                ? compile(expr)
441                : expr.accept(intExprCompiler, value);
442        if (result instanceof IntVar) {
443            // The compliation failed to reify, explicitly reify now.
444            Constraint notEq = _arithm(value, "!=", (IntVar) result);
445            return _arithm(reify, "=", notEq.reify());
446        }
447        return _arithm(((Constraint) result).reify(), "!=", reify);
448    }

450    private Constraint compileAsConstraint(IrIntExpr expr, IntVar reify) {
451        Object result = commonSubexpressions.contains(expr)
452                ? compile(expr)
453                : expr.accept(intExprCompiler, reify);
454        if (result instanceof IntVar) {
455            // The compliation failed to reify, explicitly reify now.

461    private Constraint compileAsConstraint(IrSetExpr expr, SetVar reify) {
462        Object result = commonSubexpressions.contains(expr)
463                ? compile(expr)
464                : expr.accept(setExprCompiler, reify);
465        if (result instanceof SetVar) {
466            SetVar set = (SetVar) result;
467            // The compliation failed to reify, explicitly reify now.
468            return _equal(reify, set);
469        }
470        return (Constraint) result;
471    }

473    private Constraint compileAsConstraint(IrIntArrayExpr expr, IntVar[] reify) {
474        Object result = commonSubexpressions.contains(expr)
475                ? compile(expr)
476                : expr.accept(intArrayExprCompiler, reify);
477        if (result instanceof IntVar[]) {
478            IntVar[] array = (IntVar[]) result;
479            // The compliation failed to reify, explicitly reify now.
480            return Constraints.equal(reify, array);
481        }
482        return (Constraint) result;
483    }

485    private Constraint compileArithm(IrIntExpr a, Rel op, int b) {
486        return compileArithm(a, op, Irs.constant(b));
487    }
488
489    private Constraint compileArithm(IrIntExpr a, Rel op, IrIntExpr b) {
490        if (a instanceof IrMinus) {
491            IrMinus minus = (IrMinus) a;
492            // -a ◁ b <=> a + b ▷ 0
493            return compileArithm(minus.getExpr(), Arithm.ADD, b, op.reverse(), 0);
494        }
495        if (b instanceof IrMinus) {
496            IrMinus minus = (IrMinus) b;
497            // a ◁ -b <=> a + b ◁ 0
498            return compileArithm(a, Arithm.ADD, minus.getExpr(), op, 0);
499        }
500        if (a instanceof IrNot) {
501            IrNot not = (IrNot) a;
502            // !a ◁ b <=> 1 - a ◁ b <=> a + b ▷ 1
503            return compileArithm(not.getExpr(), Arithm.ADD, b, op.reverse(), 1);
504        }
505        if (b instanceof IrNot) {
506            IrNot not = (IrNot) b;
507            // a ◁ !b <=> a ◁ 1 - b <=> a + b ◁ 1
508            return compileArithm(a, Arithm.ADD, not.getExpr(), op, 1);
509        }
510        switch (op) {
511            case EQ:
512                if (b instanceof IrVar) {
513                    return compileAsConstraint(a, compile(b));
514                }
515                return compileAsConstraint(b, compile(a));
516            case NQ:
517                if (a instanceof IrVar && b instanceof IrVar) {
518                    return _arithm(compile(a), "!=", compile(b));
519                }
520                if (a instanceof IrBoolExpr && b instanceof IrBoolExpr) {
521                    IrBoolExpr boolA = (IrBoolExpr) a;
522                    IrBoolExpr boolB = (IrBoolExpr) b;
523                    if (boolA instanceof IrCompare) {
524                        return compileAsConstraint(boolA.negate(), compileAsIntVar(boolB));
525                    }
526                    if (boolB instanceof IrCompare) {
527                        return compileAsConstraint(boolB.negate(), compileAsIntVar(boolA));
528                    }
529                    if (boolA instanceof IrBoolVar) {
530                        return compileAsConstraint(boolB, compileAsIntVar(boolA.negate()));
531                    }
532                    return compileAsConstraint(boolA, compileAsIntVar(boolB.negate()));
533                }
534        }
535        return _arithm(compile(a), op.getSyntax(), compile(b));
536    }
537
538    private Constraint compileArithm(IrIntExpr a, Rel op1, IrIntExpr b, Arithm op2, int c) {
539        if (c == 0) {
540            return compileArithm(a, op1, b);
541        }
542        if (a.isConstant()) {
543            int constant = a.getLowBound();
544            // a ◁ b + c <=> b ▷ a - c
545            // a ◁ b - c <=> b ▷ a + c
546            return compileArithm(b, op1.reverse(), op2.negate().compute(constant, c));
547        }
548        if (b.isConstant()) {
549            int constant = b.getLowBound();
550            return compileArithm(a, op1, op2.compute(constant, c));
551        }
552        if (a instanceof IrMinus) {
553            IrMinus minus = (IrMinus) a;
554            // -a ◁ b + c <=> a + b ▷ -c
555            // -a ◁ b - c <=> a + b ▷ c
556            return compileArithm(minus.getExpr(), Arithm.ADD, b, op1.reverse(),
557                    Arithm.ADD.equals(op2) ? -c : c);
558        }
559        if (b instanceof IrMinus) {
560            IrMinus minus = (IrMinus) b;
561            // a ◁ -b + c <=> a + b ▷ c
562            // a ◁ -b - c <=> a + b ▷ -c
563            return compileArithm(a, Arithm.ADD, minus.getExpr(), op1.reverse(),
564                    Arithm.ADD.equals(op2) ? c : -c);
565        }
566        if (a instanceof IrAdd) {
567            IrAdd add = (IrAdd) a;
568            IrIntExpr[] addends = add.getAddends();
569            if (addends.length == 1) {
570                // a + d ◁ b + c <=> a ◁ b + (c - d)
571                // a + d ◁ b - c <=> a ◁ b - (c + d)
572                return compileArithm(addends[0], op1, b, op2,
573                        Arithm.ADD.equals(op2) ? c - add.getOffset() : c + add.getOffset());
574            }
575        }
576        if (b instanceof IrAdd) {
577            IrAdd add = (IrAdd) b;
578            IrIntExpr[] addends = add.getAddends();
579            if (addends.length == 1) {
580                // a ◁ b + d + c <=> a ◁ b + (c + d)
581                // a ◁ b + d - c <=> a ◁ b - (c - d)
582                return compileArithm(a, op1, addends[0], op2,
583                        Arithm.ADD.equals(op2) ? c + add.getOffset() : c - add.getOffset());
584            }
585        }
586        if (a instanceof IrNot) {
587            IrNot not = (IrNot) a;
588            // !a ◁ b + c <=> 1 - a ◁ b + c <=> a + b ▷ 1 - c
589            // !a ◁ b - c <=> 1 - a ◁ b - c <=> a + b ▷ 1 + c
590            return compileArithm(not.getExpr(), Arithm.ADD, b, op1.reverse(),
591                    Arithm.ADD.equals(op2) ? 1 - c : 1 + c);
592        }
593        if (b instanceof IrNot) {
594            IrNot not = (IrNot) b;
595            // a ◁ !b + c <=> a ◁ 1 - b + c <=> a + b ▷ 1 + c
596            // a ◁ !b - c <=> a ◁ 1 - b - c <=> a + b ▷ 1 - c
597            return compileArithm(a, Arithm.ADD, not.getExpr(), op1.reverse(),
598                    Arithm.ADD.equals(op2) ? 1 + c : 1 - c);
599        }
600        return _arithm(compile(a), op1.getSyntax(), compile(b), op2.getSyntax(), c);
601    }
602
603    private Constraint compileArithm(IrIntExpr a, Arithm op1, IrIntExpr b, Rel op2, int c) {
604        if (a.isConstant()) {
605            int constant = a.getLowBound();
606            // a + b ◁ c <=> b ◁ c - a
607            // a - b ◁ c <=> b ▷ a - c
608            return Arithm.ADD.equals(op1)
609                    ? compileArithm(b, op2, c - constant)
610                    : compileArithm(b, op2.reverse(), constant - c);
611        }
612        if (b.isConstant()) {
613            // a + b ◁ c <=> a ◁ c - b
614            // a - b ◁ c <=> a ◁ c + b
615            int constant = b.getLowBound();
616            return compileArithm(a, op2, op1.negate().compute(c, constant));
617        }
618        if (b instanceof IrMinus) {
619            IrMinus minus = (IrMinus) b;
620            // a + (-b) ◁ c <=> a - b ◁ c
621            // a - (-b) ◁ c <=> a + b ◁ c
622            return compileArithm(a, op1.negate(), minus.getExpr(), op2, c);
623        }
624        if (a instanceof IrAdd) {
625            IrAdd add = (IrAdd) a;
626            IrIntExpr[] addends = add.getAddends();
627            if (addends.length == 1) {
628                // a + d + b ◁ c <=> a + b ◁ (c - d)
629                // a + d - b ◁ c <=> a - b ◁ (c - d)
630                return compileArithm(addends[0], op1, b, op2, c - add.getOffset());
631            }
632        }
633        if (b instanceof IrAdd) {
634            IrAdd add = (IrAdd) b;
635            IrIntExpr[] addends = add.getAddends();
636            if (addends.length == 1) {
637                // a + b + d ◁ c <=> a + b ◁ (c - d)
638                // a - (b + d) ◁ c <=> a - b ◁ (c + d)
639                return compileArithm(a, op1, addends[0], op2,
640                        Arithm.ADD.equals(op1) ? c - add.getOffset() : c + add.getOffset());
641            }
642        }
643        switch (op1) {
644            case ADD:
645                if (a instanceof IrNot) {
646                    IrNot not = (IrNot) a;
647                    // !a + b ◁ c <=> 1 - a + b ◁ c <=> b ◁ a + c - 1
648                    return compileArithm(b, op2, not.getExpr(), Arithm.ADD, c - 1);
649                }
650                if (b instanceof IrNot) {
651                    IrNot not = (IrNot) b;
652                    // a + !b ◁ c <=> a + 1 - b ◁ c <=> a ◁ b + c - 1
653                    return compileArithm(a, op2, not.getExpr(), Arithm.ADD, c - 1);
654                }
655                if (a instanceof IrMinus) {
656                    IrMinus minus = (IrMinus) a;
657                    // (-a) + b ◁ c <=> b - a ◁ c
658                    return compileArithm(b, Arithm.MINUS, minus.getExpr(), op2, c);
659                }
660                break;
661            case MINUS:
662                if (a instanceof IrNot) {
663                    IrNot not = (IrNot) a;
664                    // !a - b ◁ c <=> 1 - a - b ◁ c <=> -a - b ◁ c - 1 <=> a + b ▷ 1 - c
665                    return compileArithm(not.getExpr(), Arithm.ADD, b, op2.reverse(), 1 - c);
666                }
667                if (b instanceof IrNot) {
668                    IrNot not = (IrNot) b;
669                    // a - !b ◁ c <=> a - 1 + b ◁ c <=> a + b ◁ c + 1
670                    return compileArithm(a, Arithm.ADD, not.getExpr(), op2, c + 1);
671                }
672                if (a instanceof IrMinus) {
673                    IrMinus minus = (IrMinus) a;
674                    // (-a) - b ◁ c <=> a + b ▷ -c
675                    return compileArithm(minus.getExpr(), Arithm.ADD, b, op2.reverse(), -c);
676                }
677                break;
678        }
679        return _arithm(compile(a), op1.getSyntax(), compile(b), op2.getSyntax(), c);
680    }
681
682    private Constraint compileArithm(IrIntExpr a, IrCompare.Op op, IrIntExpr b) {
683        return compileArithm(a, Rel.from(op), b);
684    }

785    private final IrBoolExprVisitor<BoolArg, Object> boolExprCompiler = new IrBoolExprVisitor<BoolArg, Object>() {
786        @Override
787        public Object visit(IrRegister ir, BoolArg a) {
788            IrVar variable = ir.getVariable();
789            if (variable instanceof IrBoolVar) {
790                compile((IrBoolVar) variable);
791            } else if (variable instanceof IrIntVar) {
792                compile((IrIntVar) variable);
793            } else if (variable instanceof IrSetVar) {
794                compile((IrSetVar) variable);
795            } else {
796                compile((IrStringVar) variable);
797            }
798            return model.trueConstraint();
799        }
800
801        @Override
802        public Object visit(IrBoolVar ir, BoolArg a) {
803            return getBoolVar(ir);
804        }
805
806        @Override
807        public Object visit(IrNot ir, BoolArg a) {
808            Object expr = compile(ir.getExpr());
809            if (expr instanceof Constraint) {
810                return ((Constraint) expr).getOpposite();
811            }
812            BoolVar var = (BoolVar) expr;
813            if (a.hasReify()) {
814                return _arithm(a.useReify(), "!=", var);
815            }
816            return Preference.Constraint.equals(a.getPreference())
817                    ? _arithm(var, "=", 0)
818                    : var.not();
819        }
820
821        @Override
822        public Object visit(IrAnd ir, BoolArg a) {
823            IrBoolExpr[] operands = ir.getOperands();
824            switch (operands.length) {
825                case 1:
826                    // delegate
827                    return operands[0].accept(this, a);
828                case 2:
829                    return compileArithm(operands[0], Arithm.ADD, operands[1], Rel.EQ, 2);
830                default:
831                    return Constraints.and(compileAsBoolVars(ir.getOperands()));
832            }
833        }
834
835        @Override
836        public Object visit(IrLone ir, BoolArg a) {
837            IrBoolExpr[] operands = ir.getOperands();
838            switch (operands.length) {
839                case 1:
840                    return model.trueConstraint();
841                case 2:
842                    return compileArithm(operands[0], Arithm.ADD, operands[1], Rel.LE, 1);
843                default:
844                    return Constraints.lone(compileAsBoolVars(ir.getOperands()));
845            }
846        }
847
848        @Override
849        public Object visit(IrOne ir, BoolArg a) {
850            IrBoolExpr[] operands = ir.getOperands();
851            switch (operands.length) {
852                case 1:
853                    // delegate
854                    return operands[0].accept(this, a);
855                case 2:
856                    return compileArithm(operands[0], Arithm.ADD, operands[1], Rel.EQ, 1);
857                default:
858                    return Constraints.one(compileAsBoolVars(ir.getOperands()));
859            }
860        }
861
862        @Override
863        public Object visit(IrOr ir, BoolArg a) {
864            IrBoolExpr[] operands = ir.getOperands();
865            switch (operands.length) {
866                case 1:
867                    // delegate
868                    return operands[0].accept(this, a);
869                case 2:
870                    return operands[1].isNegative()
871                            ? compileArithm(not(operands[1]), Rel.LE, operands[0])
872                            : compileArithm(not(operands[0]), Rel.LE, operands[1]);
873                default:
874                    return Constraints.or(compileAsBoolVars(ir.getOperands()));
875            }
876        }
877
878        @Override
879        public Object visit(IrIfThenElse ir, BoolArg a) {
880            BoolVar antecedent = compileAsBoolVar(ir.getAntecedent());
881            BoolVar consequent = compileAsBoolVar(ir.getConsequent());
882            BoolVar alternative = compileAsBoolVar(ir.getAlternative());
883            return _ifThenElse(antecedent, consequent, alternative);
884        }
885
886        @Override
887        public Object visit(IrIfOnlyIf ir, BoolArg a) {
888            IrBoolExpr left = ir.getLeft();
889            IrBoolExpr right = ir.getRight();
890            if (left.isNegative()) {
891                return compileArithm(ir.getLeft().negate(), Rel.NQ, ir.getRight());
892            }
893            if (right.isNegative()) {
894                return compileArithm(ir.getLeft(), Rel.NQ, ir.getRight().negate());
895            }
896            return compileArithm(ir.getLeft(), Rel.EQ, ir.getRight());
897        }
898
899        @Override
900        public Object visit(IrCompare ir, BoolArg a) {
901            IrCompare.Op op = ir.getOp();
902            IrIntExpr left = ir.getLeft();
903            IrIntExpr right = ir.getRight();
904            if (left instanceof IrAdd) {
905                IrAdd add = (IrAdd) left;
906                IrIntExpr[] addends = add.getAddends();
907                if (addends.length == 1) {
908                    return compileArithm(addends[0], Arithm.MINUS, right, op, -add.getOffset());
909                }
910                if (addends.length == 2) {
911                    if (right.isConstant()) {
912                        return compileArithm(addends[0], Arithm.ADD, addends[1], op, right.getLowBound() - add.getOffset());
913                    }
914                }
915            }
916            if (right instanceof IrAdd) {
917                IrAdd add = (IrAdd) right;
918                IrIntExpr[] addends = add.getAddends();
919                if (addends.length == 1) {
920                    return compileArithm(left, Arithm.MINUS, addends[0], op, add.getOffset());
921                }
922                if (addends.length == 2) {
923                    if (left.isConstant()) {
924                        return compileArithm(left.getLowBound() - add.getOffset(), op, addends[0], Arithm.ADD, addends[1]);
925                    }
926                }
927            }
928            if (IrCompare.Op.Equal.equals(op)) {
929                if (a.hasReify()) {
930                    BoolVar reify = a.useReify();
931                    return right instanceof IrIntVar
932                            ? compileAsEqual(left, compile(right), reify)
933                            : compileAsEqual(right, compile(left), reify);
934                }
935                if (a.getPreference().equals(Preference.BoolVar)) {
936                    return right instanceof IrIntVar
937                            ? compileAsEqualVar(left, compile(right))
938                            : compileAsEqualVar(right, compile(left));
939                }
940            } else if (IrCompare.Op.NotEqual.equals(op)) {
941                if (a.hasReify()) {
942                    BoolVar reify = a.useReify();
943                    return right instanceof IrIntVar
944                            ? compileAsNotEqual(left, compile(right), reify)
945                            : compileAsNotEqual(right, compile(left), reify);
946                }
947                if (a.getPreference().equals(Preference.BoolVar)) {
948                    return right instanceof IrIntVar
949                            ? compileAsNotEqualVar(left, compile(right))
950                            : compileAsNotEqualVar(right, compile(left));
951                }
952            }
953            return compileArithm(left, op, right);
954        }
955
956        @Override
957        public Object visit(IrArrayEquality ir, BoolArg a) {
958            switch (ir.getOp()) {
959                case Equal:
960                    if (ir.getRight() instanceof IrIntArrayVar) {
961                        return compileAsConstraint(ir.getLeft(), compile(ir.getRight()));
962                    }
963                    return compileAsConstraint(ir.getRight(), compile(ir.getLeft()));
964                case NotEqual:
965                    return compileAsConstraint(ir.getRight(), compile(ir.getLeft())).getOpposite();
966                default:
967                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected operator.");
968            }
969        }

974                case Equal:
975                    if (ir.getRight() instanceof IrSetVar) {
976                        return compileAsConstraint(ir.getLeft(), compile(ir.getRight()));
977                    }
978                    return compileAsConstraint(ir.getRight(), compile(ir.getLeft()));
979                case NotEqual:
980                    return _not_equal(compile(ir.getLeft()), compile(ir.getRight()));
981                default:
982                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected operator.");

986        @Override
987        public Object visit(IrStringCompare ir, BoolArg a) {

990            switch (ir.getOp()) {

998                            string2.getChars(), string2.getLength());

1001                case LessThanEqual:
1002                    return Constraints.lessThanEqual(string1.getChars(), string2.getChars());
1003                default:
1004                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unexpected operator.");
1005            }
1006        }

1136        private Pair<Integer, IrIntExpr> getCoefficient(IrIntExpr e) {
1137            if (e instanceof IrMinus) {
1138                return new Pair<>(-1, ((IrMinus) e).getExpr());
1139            } else if (e instanceof IrMul) {
1140                IrMul mul = (IrMul) e;
1141                if (mul.getMultiplicand().isConstant()) {
1142                    return new Pair<>(mul.getMultiplicand().getLowBound(), mul.getMultiplier());
1143                }
1144                if (mul.getMultiplier().isConstant()) {
1145                    return new Pair<>(mul.getMultiplier().getLowBound(), mul.getMultiplicand());
1146                }
1147            }
1148            return new Pair<>(1, e);
1149        }
1150
1151        private Pair<int[], IrIntExpr[]> getCoefficients(IrIntExpr[] es) {
1152            int[] coefficients = new int[es.length];
1153            IrIntExpr[] exprs = new IrIntExpr[es.length];
1154            for (int i = 0; i < es.length; i++) {
1155                Pair<Integer, IrIntExpr> coef = getCoefficient(es[i]);
1156                coefficients[i] = coef.getFst();
1157                exprs[i] = coef.getSnd();
1158            }
1159            return new Pair<>(coefficients, exprs);
1160        }
1161
1162        @Override
1163        public Object visit(IrAdd ir, IntVar reify) {
1164            int offset = ir.getOffset();
1165            IrIntExpr[] addends = ir.getAddends();
1166            switch (addends.length) {
1167                case 0:
1168                    // This case should have already been optimized earlier.
1169                    return model.intVar(offset);
1170                case 1:
1171                    if (reify == null) {
1172                        return _offset(compile(addends[0]), offset);
1173                    }
1174                    return _arithm(reify, "-", compile(addends[0]), "=", offset);
1175                default:
1176                    Pair<int[], IrIntExpr[]> coeffs = getCoefficients(addends);
1177                    int[] coefficients = coeffs.getFst();
1178                    IntVar[] operands = compile(coeffs.getSnd());
1179                    if (reify == null) {
1180                        IntVar sum = numIntVar("Sum", ir.getDomain().offset(-offset));
1181                        post(_scalar(sum, coefficients, operands));
1182                        return _offset(sum, offset);
1183                    }
1184                    if (offset != 0) {
1185                        coefficients = Util.cons(1, coefficients);
1186                        operands = Util.cons(model.intVar(offset), operands);
1187                    }
1188                    return _scalar(reify, coefficients, operands);
1189            }
1190        }
1191
1192        @Override
1193        public Object visit(IrMul ir, IntVar reify) {
1194            IrIntExpr multiplicand = ir.getMultiplicand();
1195            IrIntExpr multiplier = ir.getMultiplier();
1196            if (multiplicand.isConstant()) {
1197                switch (multiplicand.getLowBound()) {
1198                    case 0:
1199                        return compileAsConstraint(multiplicand, reify);
1200                    case 1:
1201                        return compileAsConstraint(multiplier, reify);
1202                    default:
1203                        if (multiplicand.getLowBound() >= -1) {
1204                            return _scale(compile(multiplier), multiplicand.getLowBound());
1205                        }
1206                        return _minus(_scale(compile(multiplier), -multiplicand.getLowBound()));
1207                }
1208            }
1209            if (multiplier.isConstant()) {
1210                switch (multiplier.getLowBound()) {
1211                    case 0:
1212                        return compileAsConstraint(multiplier, reify);
1213                    case 1:
1214                        return compileAsConstraint(multiplicand, reify);
1215                    default:
1216                        if (multiplier.getLowBound() >= -1) {
1217                            return _scale(compile(multiplicand), multiplier.getLowBound());
1218                        }
1219                        return _minus(_scale(compile(multiplicand), -multiplier.getLowBound()));
1220                }
1221            }
1222            if (reify != null) {
1223                return _times(compile(multiplicand), compile(multiplier), reify);
1224            }
1225            IntVar product = numIntVar("Mul", ir.getDomain());
1226            post(_times(compile(multiplicand), compile(multiplier), product));
1227            return product;
1228        }

1770    private Constraint _sum(IntVar sum, IntVar... vars) {
1771        for (IntVar var : vars) {
1772            if (!(var instanceof BoolVar)) {
1773                return model.sum(vars, "=", sum);
1774            }
1775        }
1776        return _sum(sum, Arrays.copyOf(vars, vars.length, BoolVar[].class));
1777    }
1778
1779    private Constraint _sum(IntVar sum, BoolVar... vars) {
1780        return model.sum(vars, "=", sum);
1781    }
1782
1783    private Constraint _scalar(IntVar sum, int[] coefficients, IntVar[] vars) {
1784        boolean allOnes = true;
1785        for (int coefficient : coefficients) {
1786            if (coefficient != 1) {
1787                allOnes = false;
1788                break;
1789            }
1790        }
1791        if (allOnes) {
1792            return _sum(sum, vars);
1793        }
1794        return model.scalar(vars, coefficients, "=", sum);
1795    }

1805    private Constraint _mod(IntVar dividend, IntVar divisor, IntVar remainder) {
1806        if (divisor.contains(0)) {
1807            model.post(_arithm(divisor, "!=", 0));
1808        }
1809        return model.mod(dividend, divisor, remainder);
1810    }

1812    private Constraint _arithm(IntVar var1, String op1, IntVar var2, String op2, int cste) {
1813        if (cste == 0) {
1814            switch (Operator.get(op2)) {
1815                case PL:
1816                case MN:
1817                    return model.arithm(var1, op1, var2);
1818            }
1819        }
1820        return model.arithm(var1, op1, var2, op2, cste);
1821    }

1955    private static enum Rel {
1956
1957        EQ("="),
1958        NQ("!="),
1959        LT("<"),
1960        LE("<="),
1961        GT(">"),
1962        GE(">=");
1963        private final String syntax;
1964
1965        private Rel(String syntax) {
1966            this.syntax = syntax;
1967        }
1968
1969        private String getSyntax() {
1970            return syntax;
1971        }
1972
1973        private static Rel from(IrCompare.Op op) {
1974            switch (op) {
1975                case Equal:
1976                    return EQ;
1977                case NotEqual:
1978                    return NQ;
1979                case LessThanEqual:
1980                    return LE;
1981                default:
1982                    throw new IllegalArgumentException();
1983            }
1984        }
1985
1986        private Rel reverse() {
1987            switch (this) {
1988                case LT:
1989                    return GT;
1990                case LE:
1991                    return GE;
1992                case GT:
1993                    return LT;
1994                case GE:
1995                    return LE;
1996                default:
1997                    return this;
1998            }
1999        }
2000    }
2001
2002    private static enum Arithm {
2003
2004        ADD("+"),
2005        MINUS("-");
2006        private final String syntax;
2007
2008        private Arithm(String syntax) {
2009            this.syntax = syntax;
2010        }
2011
2012        private String getSyntax() {
2013            return syntax;
2014        }
2015
2016        private int compute(int a, int b) {
2017            switch (this) {
2018                case ADD:
2019                    return a + b;
2020                case MINUS:
2021                    return a - b;
2022                default:
2023                    throw new IllegalStateException();
2024            }
2025        }
2026
2027        private Arithm negate() {
2028            switch (this) {
2029                case ADD:
2030                    return MINUS;
2031                case MINUS:
2032                    return ADD;
2033                default:
2034                    throw new IllegalStateException();
2035            }
2036        }
2037    }
2038    private static final BoolArg ConstraintNoReify = new BoolArg(null, Preference.Constraint);
2039    private static final BoolArg BoolVarNoReify = new BoolArg(null, Preference.BoolVar);
2040
2041    private static class BoolArg {
2042
2043        // The solution needs to be reified in this variable.
2044        // Set to null if no reification needed.
2045        private BoolVar reify;
2046        // The prefered type of solution.
2047        private final Preference preference;
2048
2049        BoolArg(BoolVar reify, Preference preference) {
2050            this.reify = reify;
2051            this.preference = preference;
2052        }
2053
2054        boolean hasReify() {
2055            return reify != null;
2056        }
2057
2058        BoolVar useReify() {
2059            BoolVar tmp = reify;
2060            reify = null;
2061            return tmp;
2062        }
2063
2064        Preference getPreference() {
2065            return preference;
2066        }
2067    }
2068
2069    private static enum Preference {
2070
2071        Constraint,
2072        BoolVar;
2073    }
2074}
